card.name: All-caps warning text and hyphens
card.fires_on: Small joining pieces (a hyphen, 'WITH', 'AN', 'THERE', partway-through-word endings) inside long ALL-CAPS boxed warning sentences. A second, rarer setting is the hyphen after a number range in botanical descriptions.

modes.label: Caps warning text
modes.description: Linking words or word parts inside upper-case warning passages about allergic reactions and emergency treatment.
modes.example: SERIOUS ANAPHYLACTIC REACTIONS REQUIRE IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY TREATMENT<< WITH>> EPINEPHRINE

modes.label: Hyphen after number
modes.description: A hyphen joining a number or fraction to the next word, as in dose fractions or plant descriptions.
modes.example: Ovary inferior or semi-inferior, 2–5<<->>loculed, with 2 ovules

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted words relate to infrastructure and the suppressed ones to 'inf' spellings.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words inside shouted all-capital warnings, and on hyphens after numbers.
